columns.title: Usage %
columns.desc: Share of team possessions a player finishes himself (shot, free throws or turnover) while on court. The higher, the more the offense runs through him.

columns.title: True shooting %
columns.desc: Shooting efficiency that credits threes and free throws: PTS ÷ (2 × (FGA + 0.44 × FTA)). Better than plain FG%.

columns.title: Individual offensive rating
columns.desc: Points a player produces per 100 possessions he uses (own scoring, assists, offensive rebounds).

columns.title: Assist %
columns.desc: Share of the player's plays that end with an assist rather than a shot or turnover.

columns.title: Turnover %
columns.desc: Share of the player's plays that end in a turnover. Lower is better.

columns.title: 3PA rate
columns.desc: Share of the player's field-goal attempts taken from three.

columns.title: Created points
columns.desc: Points scored himself plus points teammates scored from his assists.

columns.title: Fouls drawn
columns.desc: Fouls drawn per game. They add to PIR.

columns.title: Offensive rebound %
columns.desc: Share of available offensive rebounds (after team misses) he grabs while on court.

columns.title: Individual defensive rating
columns.desc: Points allowed per 100 opponent possessions, based on the player's defensive contribution. Lower is better.

columns.title: Defensive rebound %
columns.desc: Share of available defensive rebounds (after opponent misses) he grabs while on court.

columns.title: Steal %
columns.desc: Share of opponent possessions, while he is on court, that end with his steal.

columns.title: Block %
columns.desc: Share of opponent shot attempts he blocks while on court.

columns.title: Stops
columns.desc: Opponent possessions per game he ends on defense (steal, block, defensive rebound, forced miss).

columns.title: Stop %
columns.desc: Share of opponent possessions he stops while on court.

columns.title: Individual net rating
columns.desc: Individual offensive minus defensive rating: points per 100 possessions the player adds.

columns.title: Team ORtg with him on court
columns.desc: Team points scored per 100 possessions while he is on court.

columns.title: Team DRtg with him on court
columns.desc: Opponent points per 100 possessions while he is on court. Lower is better.

columns.title: Assists / turnovers
columns.desc: Assists per turnover.

columns.title: Possessions per game
columns.desc: Possessions played per game while he is on court. Reflects minutes and pace.

columns.title: Performance index rating
columns.desc: PTS + REB + AST + STL + BLK + fouls drawn − missed shots − turnovers − blocks against − fouls.
